verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe the Devin CLI as "a local command-line coding agent" and show a terminal invocation (`devin -- check out this code...`). A `--sandbox` flag adds OS-level isolation for local runs, and Handoff lets you pass tasks to the cloud while you keep working locally. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and deeper documentation of installation and local-execution workflow details.
